queries: site:counterpointresearch.com Foundry 2.0 Q2 2026 TSMC CoWoS EMIB-T Google TPU Intel September 2026
"AI’s Semiconductor Boom Has a Clear Center of Gravity" Taiwan Semiconductor Benzinga September 30 2026
Intel EMIB-T adopted Google's next-generation TPU Counterpoint September 2026

content.text:
Intel’s EMIB packaging gains traction as chip designers look to skirt TSMC’s CoWoS constraints — Google’s reported decision for 9th-gen TPUs highlights Intel’s attractive alternative: The article attributes to SemiAnalysis a report that Google planned to use Intel EMIB-T for a next-generation TPU codenamed Humufish. It presents this as a reported plan, discusses uncertainties, and does not provide a binding order or company confirmation. (time=2026-07-15; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
AI Chip Packaging Pushes Beyond Reticle Limits, with CoWoS-L Set to Remain the Mainstream Advanced Packaging Solution Through 2028, Says TrendForce: TrendForce said Google was expected to adopt EMIB-T packaging in 2027 and AWS was testing EMIB. It also expected CoWoS-L to remain mainstream through 2028, citing its technology maturity and yield advantages. These are forecasts and assessments, not confirmation of a completed Google production decision. (time=2026-09-18; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
AI’s Semiconductor Boom Has a Clear Center of Gravity: Taiwan Semiconductor: Benzinga attributes to Counterpoint the statement that EMIB-T had been adopted for Google’s next-generation TPU. It also reports Counterpoint’s broader view that TSMC remained the central beneficiary and that Intel and Samsung did not match its advanced-node scale, yield and packaging execution. The story does not document a binding order, production volume or company confirmation. (time=2026-09-30T11:15:34Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

queries: Counterpoint Research Q2 2026 foundry 2.0 market $96.6 billion September 30 2026 EMIB-T Intel Google

content.text:
Global Foundry 2.0 Revenue Rises 25% YoY to a Record $96.6 Billion in Q2 2026 as Advanced Packaging Takes Center Stage: The dated release reports Q2 2026 Foundry 2.0 revenue of $96.6 billion, TSMC revenue of $40.2 billion and about 42% market share, plus a projected CoWoS supply-demand gap of about 20% in 2026 narrowing to about 10% in 2027. The current search-indexed version also contains an EMIB-T/Google adoption sentence, but its presence in a pre-cutoff version could not be verified; that sentence is not relied on as time-verified primary evidence. (time=2026-09-29; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
AI Boom Extends to Packaging and Testing… ‘Foundry 2.0’ Revenue Up 25%: EDaily attributes to Counterpoint Senior Research Analyst William Li the statement that Intel EMIB-T packaging was adopted for Google’s next-generation TPU. It also reports Li’s caveat that Samsung and Intel did not yet match TSMC in advanced-process scale, yields and packaging execution. The English page identifies itself as machine-translated. It gives no TPU model, order, qualification, volume or production timing. (time=2026-09-30 19:07:59 KST (2026-09-30T10:07:59Z); cutoff=UNKNOWN).
